route.name: Hosshinmon-oji to Kumano Hongu Taisha then Oyunohara
route.walking_time: 2-3 hours (official baseline; allow at least 3.5h with stamps, photos and visits)

gpx_contains: 10 stamp location waypoints only; no route track geometry
coordinate_caveat: Coordinates are navigation reference points for named landmarks, not guaranteed exact stamp-stand coordinates. Stamp stands can move; follow official signs and ask shrine/temple staff. Stamp-06 is an approximate Oyunohara giant-torii entrance vicinity point; stamp-10 is the Geoshape historic place-name representative point for Hiro-jinja.

offline_site_cache.note: Service worker caches first-party site resources after first successful HTTPS visit. Download official PDF and offline basemap separately in the chosen navigation app.

credential_record_options.free_dual_pilgrim_credential: Confirmed option. Stamp Kumano Hongu Taisha both in route position 05 and on the first page of the Kumano side under COMPLETION OF PILGRIMAGE.
credential_record_options.association_issued_booklet: Official FAQ Q2 allows a Tourist Association-issued stamp booklet paired with a Santiago-recognized credential, but the exact booklet must be pre-approved by the Tanabe City Kumano Tourism Bureau. Do not assume every association or Nakahechi booklet is eligible.
credential_record_options.not_eligible: The JPY 100 / 41-stamp Wakayama Prefecture Nakahechi booklet belongs to a separate stamp campaign and is explicitly not eligible for Dual Pilgrim certification.

google_maps_import.notes: CSV is for Google My Maps import. Location field contains coordinates or addresses/place names. Some place names are geocoded by My Maps; verify unmatched entries manually.
google_maps_import.individual_maps_urls: The website also provides one-tap Google Maps search links for every hotel, stamp point, photo spot and restaurant.
